columns.name: execution_no
columns.definition: VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NULL

checks.ck_bty_task_action:
(action<>'TASK_ACTION' OR COALESCE((JSON_TYPE(frozen_command)='OBJECT' AND
    status='TASK_INTENDED' AND
    next_retry_at IS NULL AND
    failure_code IS NULL AND
    version=0 AND
    deleted=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='TASK_ACTION_V1' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='START_TASK' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))=submission_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))=tenant_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))=entity_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))=store_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))=work_order_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))=request_key_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.intentHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.intentHash'))=payload_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.taskNo'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.taskNo'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.requirementNo'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.requirementNo'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.roleCode'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.roleCode'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.sourceLineRef'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.sourceLineRef'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.personnelNo'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.personnelNo'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.resourceNo'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.resourceNo'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.namespaceHash'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.namespaceHash'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.targetHash'))='STRING' AND
    LENGTH(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.targetHash'))))>0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.scopeRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.scopeRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.taskVersion'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.taskVersion')>=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingVersion'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingVersion')>=0 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.sourceFenceRevision'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.sourceFenceRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.ordinal'))='INTEGER' AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.slot.ordinal')>=0),0)) OR (action='TASK_ACTION' AND COALESCE((JSON_TYPE(frozen_command)='OBJECT' AND
    status='TASK_INTENDED' AND
    version=0 AND
    deleted=0 AND
    next_retry_at IS NULL AND
    failure_code IS NULL AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='TASK_ACTION_V2' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.purpose'))='START_TASK' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actionNo'))=submission_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.intentHash'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.intentHash'))=payload_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.requestKeyHash'))=request_key_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.tenantNo'))=tenant_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.entityNo'))=entity_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.scope.storeNo'))=store_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.workOrderNo'))=work_order_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.context.taskNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.canonicalAccountNo'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.namespaceHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.targetHash'))='STRING' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.reference'))='OBJECT' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.originalBinding'))='OBJECT' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.initialPlan'))='OBJECT' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected'))='OBJECT' AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.scopeRevision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.scopeRevision')>=1 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.taskVersion'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.taskVersion')>=0 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingRevision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingRevision')>=1 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingVersion'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.bindingVersion')>=0 AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.sourceFenceRevision'))='INTEGER' AND JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.expected.sourceFenceRevision')>=1 AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.actor'))='OBJECT' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.currentPersonnel'))='OBJECT' AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":100,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"object","required":["requirementNo","ordinal","assignmentRevision"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"requirementNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"ordinal":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"assignmentRevision":{"type":"integer","minimum":1}}}}',JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.ownSlots')) AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":100,"items":{"type":"object","required":["assignmentNo","assignmentRevision","requirementNo","ordinal","roleCode","resourceNo","personnelNo","acceptActionNo","recordHash","qualificationHash","identity","canonicalAccountNo","personnel"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"assignmentNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"assignmentRevision":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"requirementNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"ordinal":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"roleCode":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"resourceNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"personnelNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"acceptActionNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"recordHash":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"qualificationHash":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"identity":{"type":"object"},"canonicalAccountNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"personnel":{"type":"object"}}}}',JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.acceptedRoster'))),0))
checks.ck_bty_task_start_columns: (action='TASK_START' AND execution_no IS NOT NULL AND action_observation_json IS NOT NULL) OR (action<>'TASK_START' AND execution_no IS NULL AND action_observation_json IS NULL)
checks.ck_bty_task_start:
action<>'TASK_START' OR COALESCE((deleted=0 AND (JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.cancellation'))='NULL' OR JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"object","required":["purpose","actionNo","actionHash","cause","source","core","denial"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"purpose":{"enum":["SOURCE_SUSPENSION","CORE_SUSPENSION","EXPLICIT_ABORT"]},"actionNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"actionHash":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},"cause":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64},"source":{"type":["object","null"]},"core":{"type":["object","null"]},"denial":{"type":["object","null"]}}}',JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.cancellation'))) AND
    execution_no IS NOT NULL AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.schema'))='TASK_START_V1' AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.submissionNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.submissionNo'))=submission_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.frozenHash'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.frozenHash'))=payload_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.reference.executionNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.reference.executionNo'))=execution_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.requestKeyHash'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.requestKeyHash'))=request_key_hash AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.workOrderNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.workOrderNo'))=work_order_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.tenantNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.tenantNo'))=tenant_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.entityNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.entityNo'))=entity_no AND
    JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.storeNo'))='STRING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(frozen_command,'$.action.context.scope.storeNo'))=store_no AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"object","required":["schema","submissionNo","action","originalPlanSchema","originalPlanJson","originalPlanHash","resourcePlanJson","resourcePlanHash","sourceGroups","booking","retention","retentionRoster","nativeKey","ackActionNo","frozenHash"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"submissionNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"action":{"type":"object"},"originalPlanSchema":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"originalPlanJson":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"originalPlanHash":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"resourcePlanJson":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"resourcePlanHash":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"sourceGroups":{"type":"array","minItems":1},"booking":{"type":["object","null"]},"retention":{"type":"object"},"retentionRoster":{"type":"array","minItems":1},"nativeKey":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"ackActionNo":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"frozenHash":{"type":"string","minLength":1}}}',frozen_command) AND
    JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"object","required":["schema","version","phase","nativeOriginal","acknowledgement","cancellation","stopRequired","pendingReason","observationHash"],"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"schema":{"enum":["TASK_START_OBSERVATION_V1"]},"version":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"phase":{"enum":["SOURCE_FROZEN","DISPATCHING","OWNER_ACCEPTED","RESOURCE_APPLIED","ACKED","ABORT_REQUESTED","RESOURCE_SEALED"]},"nativeOriginal":{"type":["object","null"]},"acknowledgement":{"type":["object","null"]},"cancellation":{"type":["object","null"]},"stopRequired":{"type":"boolean"},"pendingReason":{"type":["string","null"]},"observationHash":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"}}}',action_observation_json) AND
    JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.version')=version AND
    JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.phase'))=status AND
    (failure_code <=> JSON_UNQUOTE(NULLIF(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.pendingReason'),CAST('null' AS JSON)))) AND
    (status NOT IN ('ACKED','RESOURCE_SEALED') OR next_retry_at IS NULL OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.cancellation'))='OBJECT' OR failure_code='CORE_SUSPENSION_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED') AND
    (status NOT IN ('RESOURCE_APPLIED','ACKED') OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.nativeOriginal.applied'))='OBJECT') AND
    (status<>'ACKED' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.acknowledgement.original'))='OBJECT') AND
    (status<>'RESOURCE_SEALED' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.nativeOriginal.seal'))='OBJECT') AND
    (status<>'ABORT_REQUESTED' OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(action_observation_json,'$.cancellation'))='OBJECT' OR failure_code='CORE_SUSPENSION_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED')),0)
